_comment: Stage G (task card G-global, docs/decisions/0013): the global scope. Not frozen and not a replacement of config/regions.json, which stays frozen and still defines the three holdout regions (excluded from training and scoring; their VIIRS never reaches this machine) and the six v1 boxes. Read by harmonization/global_grid.py.

domain._comment: A cell belongs to the global table when any rule holds.
domain.any_detection: at least one cleaned detection of any sensor (Terra, Aqua, S-NPP, NOAA-20) in 2000-11..2026-10
domain.scoring_rectangles: inside any rectangle of config/rectangles.csv (so every rectangle is complete)
domain.regions_json_boxes: inside any box of config/regions.json (so the six v1 regions are complete)

regions.ocean_cells: nearest cell with a non-zero code (Euclidean in grid index units, no wrap)
regions.holdout: cells inside the holdout boxes of config/regions.json take the holdout region name and role holdout; every other cell has role train and its GFED region name
